chunks: Al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Fāṭimah عليها السلام prayed in a shift, with her headscarf upon her head; she did not have on more than that by which she covered her hair and her ears.

key_terms.دِرْعٍ: a long shirt or shift worn as a garment
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum clothing required for a woman’s salat (prayer) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how Fāṭimah عليها السلام performed salat (prayer) while wearing a simple garment and a headscarf that covered her head, hair, and ears. It is cited in the context of prayer rulings to indicate the minimum sufficient covering for a woman in prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.789 - Al-Fudayl narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A} prayed in a tunic with a headscarf covering her head, and She did not have more on than what concealed her hair and her ears”.
